items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Yeah, I played a job with him.

ctx.x: I know he didn't play. I know he played a lot of tuba.
Yeah, he had, no, he had, uh, he had put his, the tube up and he played bass with the, the, the, the Nola band. Oh, yeah? With Pila Kass.
I didn't like that. I didn't know that. Yeah, I played a job with him. I know he played a lot of tuba already.
